continuity_scope: NIS America North American English Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless, released 3 October 2023 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and PC. Character claims are bounded to the original NIS America Disgaea 7 official site’s seven Main Character and three Side Character cards. Disgaea 7 Complete (Nintendo Switch 2, 2025), its new Nethertime story/Asagi, all original-game DLC/bonus scenarios, patches, other regional localizations, and crossover/cameo content are separate states/continuities.

coverage_rule: All ten individually named figures with an official, discrete character card on the selected original Disgaea 7 site: seven Main Characters (Fuji, Pirilika, Ao, Yeyasu, Ceefore, Suisen, Higan Zesshosai) and three Side Characters (Pii-chan, Nitra, Demmodore Opener). This is the full published ten-card witness set, not a claim to exhaust the game’s story/recruitment roster. Generic units/classes, player-created recruits, unnamed demons/angels/shogunate members, weapons, Netherworlds, systems, and factions remain dimensions/terms.
omissions: All generic unit classes and player-created/recruited units, player party composition/leveling/reincarnation/equipment/AI/online-ranked choices, and player-dependent battle/ending results.

All named persons/entities without a discrete selected original-site character card, including DLC/bonus/crossover characters and scenarios, other Disgaea protagonists, Complete-only Asagi/Nethertime content, unnamed shogunate/Netherarmy members, and objects/Netherworlds/factions/mechanics as nodes.

Disgaea 7 Complete, the original game’s DLC and Special Weapons Set item content, post-release patches/balance behavior, Japanese/French and other localizations, other numbered games/remakes, anime/manga, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The official character-page text is delivered by NIS America’s own page script and is a curated ten-card presentation, not an in-game script or full canonical roster; pass-complete is limited to that witness.
The 2023 launch campaign includes a time-limited Special Weapons Set DLC and platform-specific availability. It does not establish any DLC item or bonus character as part of this original-card pass.
NIS America’s later Complete site explicitly adds all original DLC plus new stories/characters and post-main-story material; none of that content is merged into this record.
Descriptions use promotional framing and sometimes unresolved questions (notably Nitra); unverified motive/identity claims remain excluded rather than inferred.
evidence_basis: Official NIS America product, release, launch-DLC, character-card, and system pages only. Character-level claims use the original site’s card data; official release pages establish the localized/version/DLC boundary. No fan resource is used as canonical evidence.
